summary: Iter 17 — Founder Command Center + per-lead Next Best Action verified end-to-end. Backend: GET /api/insights/founder-command-center returns full required payload shape (computed_from_real_data=true since 25 demo leads exist; revenue_leakage with score_pct=95, 5-element breakdown with exact keys [overdue,hot_untouched,proposal_stuck,unassigned,lost_no_reason]; money_at_risk with INR ₹1.4Cr label + 4 rows; daily_brief with 6 lines + 'Generate Today's Sales Brief' CTA; hot_leads_untouched with 5 rows; first_response with avg 9.4h, best=Simran/22min, slowest=Rohan/14h, target_minutes=30; proposal_graveyard with rows; source_quality + lost_reasons rows; pipeline_value_label INR-formatted). 401 enforced without auth. Frontend: Dashboard mounts [data-testid=founder-command-center] with all 8 section cards (leakage-card, money-at-risk-card, daily-brief-card, hot-untouched-card, first-response-card, proposal-graveyard-card, source-quality-card, lost-reasons-card). Role tabs work flawlessly: Sales Rep correctly hides leakage/source-quality/lost-reasons; Sales Manager correctly hides leakage/daily-brief. Leakage card shows conic-gradient circle with 95% center, all 5 breakdown chips render with correct testids, CTA navigates to /follow-ups. Money at Risk shows 4 rows with INR labels + per-row action buttons. Daily Brief shows ARIA SAYS eyebrow, 6 bullet lines, Generate CTA. LeadInbox table has 'Next Best Action' column header and 20 nba-{leadId} chips with context-aware labels ('Send first-touch message', 'Handle pricing objection', 'Send pre-call brief', 'Book discovery call', 'Move to nurture sequence' all observed). No critical console errors.
action_items: [Documented mocked-as-intended] First Response Time uses placeholder values (avg 9.4h, Simran=22min, Rohan=14h) — Phase 2 work to track per-rep activity timestamps. Lost reasons fall back to demo distribution if no leads have lost_reason set. Both are intentional per PRD.
[Pre-existing, not new] react-beautiful-dnd dev warning persists on Pipeline page — non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4538 founder_command_center — solid implementation. Real metrics computed when leads exist; clean fallback to _demo_command_center_fallback when DB empty. _fmt_inr correctly handles Cr/L/K thresholds.

server.py:4694 hot_leads_untouched row builder — has nested datetime parsing in dict comprehension that could fail if created_at is malformed. Wrapped in try via int(...) fallback to 4, but a malformed ISO string would still raise. Consider try/except around the comprehension. Low priority since seeded data is well-formed.
server.py:4612 first_response — placeholder values are hardcoded inside the if-branch (avg_response_hours, fastest/slowest_rep). Acceptable for demo; document as Phase 2.
FounderCommandCenter.js — single 310-line component is borderline; would benefit from splitting each card into its own sub-component for maintainability. Currently acceptable.

FounderCommandCenter.js:34 — silent catch on api.get failure (no error state shown). If the endpoint 500s, data stays null and FCC renders nothing, with no user feedback. Consider an error tone variant.
LeadInbox.js:6 NEXT_BEST_ACTION — pure function, easy to test, good. Consider extracting tone→className mapping into a const map for clarity (currently inlined as cls).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 8 section cards render, role-tab role-gating works for all 3 roles, NBA column + chips present in LeadInbox, leakage CTA navigates correctly, no critical console errors)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing 25+ demo leads in DB (workspace plan: starter).
